rulings.restated: Add person.medicare6 over every confirmed person entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The restatement sums only box 6 Medicare tax withheld. The instructions add: 'Also include any uncollected Medicare tax on tips from Form W-2, box 12, code B, and any uncollected Medicare tax on the taxable cost of group-term life insurance over $50,000 (for former employees) from Form W-2, box 12, code N.' No refusal excludes those amounts.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: second reading right; data changed under BUG-0004. The instructions add uncollected Medicare tax from Form W-2 box 12 codes B and N to line 19 (i8959 p. 4); the line sums box 6 only and the screen `f8959.unsupported` did not name those amounts. The screen now does, so a filer with a box 12 code B or N amount is refused; the line itself is unchanged.
